title: Passkey Sign-in Flow
diagram:
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Frontend
    participant Backend
    participant IBM Verify
    participant Browser WebAuthn

    User->>Frontend: Enter username
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /auth/passkey/options
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Get admin token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Admin token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/factors/fido2/authn/options
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Authentication options
    Backend-->>Frontend: WebAuthn options
    Frontend->>Browser WebAuthn: navigator.credentials.get()
    Browser WebAuthn->>User: Prompt for biometric/PIN
    User->>Browser WebAuthn: Provide biometric/PIN
    Browser WebAuthn-->>Frontend: Credential
    Frontend->>Backend: POST /auth/passkey/verify
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /v2.0/factors/fido2/authn/verify
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Verification token
    Backend->>IBM Verify: POST /oauth2/token
    Note over Backend,IBM Verify: Exchange for access token
    IBM Verify-->>Backend: Access token
    Backend-->>Frontend: Access token
    Frontend->>Frontend: Store token & redirect to dashboard
